text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PAGERDUTY#P-81234 -> service="inference-frontend" severity=high 
incident-bot: symptom=5m error rate 8.4% (threshold 5%), affected=prod-us-east-1 cluster

Jordan: ack'd via mobile 1738800140 — looking. seeing spike in 502/504s from the edge LB.

pagerduty-bot: Alert acknowledged by Jordan at 1738800140. Next escalation in 9m if unacknowledged activity continues.

Jordan: quick check — dashboards show backend-rtp instances dropping below 2 replicas, oom events in logs. grabbing logs.

Jordan: pasted logs:
```
2026-02-12T02:02:20Z inference-rtp-2 kubelet: OOMKilled container model-worker pid=2345 mem=31.2GB
2026-02-12T02:02:21Z inference-rtp-1 ERROR runtime: kvcache miss spike, queue depth=512, latency=1200ms
```

Jordan: trying to scale up nodepool, but cloud apis returning 429 rate limit from our quota. kicked off autoscale job: `rbw infra autoscale --pool inference-rtp --add 2`

Ken: ping — are you on primary? I can take over if you need to go to sleep.

Jordan: I'm primary oncall. I'm trying to get a temporary mitigation (throttle batch size) but mobile is on DND for confirming RCA with product. I can't reach the primary owner of the model team by phone.

Jordan: paging secondary (Alyssa) as fallback — setting PD escalation to contact secondary now.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation: contacting secondary oncall Alyssa via SMS and call. Escalation policy: inference-prod -> secondary -> manager.

Alyssa: just got SMS, will join in 2 mins. on my way to laptop.

Jordan: quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce max_batch to 4 (cuts mem pressure), 2) enable kvcache hot-prefixes to avoid regen, 3) temp routing to dedicated pool with spare capacity.

Alyssa: I can run the config change. running patch now:
```
rbw apply -f - <<EOF
kind: ModelConfig
metadata:
  name: nlp-large
spec:
  runtime:
    max_batch: 4
EOF
```

Alyssa: patch applied, restarting workers in safe mode.

Jordan: good. still seeing manager escalation timer counting — PD will escalate to manager in ~4m if alerts keep flaring. keep monitoring logs.

pagerduty-bot: Attempting call to manager (Lisa). No answer. Leaving voicemail. Attempt 1/3.

Ken: any customer-visible impact? I saw a PagerDuty note marked "customer-impact = degraded" earlier.

SRE-Triage: quick check — incident impact: API 5xx to a subset of customers on us-east-1; overall TPS unchanged. Temporary errors for sessions that hit long-seq generation >1024 tokens. We should surface this to PMs/CS.

Jordan: sending a short blurb to #support: "We are experiencing increased 502/504 errors for some inference requests in us-east-1. Engineering is actively mitigating; we will update in 15m or earlier."

Alyssa: metric trends show memory pressure correlates with larger payloads from customer-xyz alpha users. throttling batches should reduce tail latency.

pagerduty-bot: Manager escalation attempt 2/3: calling Lisa (manager). No response; attempting SMS.

Lisa (manager): just woke up, on call bridge now. joining.

Lisa (manager): on bridge. timeline? need an ETA for customer update and whether to open a SEV ticket for enterprise customers.

Jordan: mitigation applied (max_batch down). error rate dropping from 8.4% -> 3.1% in last 90s. leaving rolling observation.

Alyssa: enabling temporary routing to dedicated spare pool for heavy-seq customers. command:
```
rbw route --service inference-frontend --filter "x-seq-length>1024" --to pool:dedicated-spare-1
```

Alyssa: routing change deployed. samples show successful responses for previously failing requests.

SRE-Triage: recommend escalation state -> resolved if error rate stays <4% for 10 mins, else continue full SEV. Also recommend postmortem to cover quota hardening for autoscale.

Ken: thanks all. Jordan/Alyssa — can someone create incident channel notes and add customers impacted list? I'll notify CS for enterprise outreach.

Jordan: creating incident doc now, linking to bridge and timeline.

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved: PAGERDUTY#P-81234 at 1738800580 by Alyssa (escalation).

Alyssa: marking the issue as mitigated. We'll keep monitoring; follow-up action items: increase autoscale quota, add pre-warm for model-worker, investigate root cause of OOM.

Lisa (manager): good work. please add owner for postmortem and set priority P1? (we had customer impact for alpha).

Jordan: assigning postmortem owner: Ken. will draft summary. will add timeline + actions.

pagerduty-bot: Thread closed. If errors recur, a new alert will be generated and the escalation cycle will restart. :white_check_mark:
